I117-SoftEng completed against input `96dbf57d0da7f3027e59109c1846d992d68d4d44`.

Implemented an opt-in Si-W prototype using unchanged MarlinReco silicon code and `EnergyDigi`, pinned to `255967eb855ebbc8f75ebaac190b268b63332e8b`, in a separate GPL executable. Added channel enumeration, deterministic event seeds, explicit stored-cell-position conversion, noise-only persistence without fabricated truth, configuration metadata, documentation and tests.

Validation: build succeeded; **5/5 CTest suites passed**, including eight silicon tests. Noise fixture: 200,000 samples, configured RMS 0.2 MIP, measured RMS 0.200103546; 4,518 entries above 0.4 MIP versus 4,550.026 expected. `git diff --check` passed.

Most work is committed by coordinator as `1deb638b626d2fb9f608f221879a069a9cc2da41`. Final uncommitted robustness correction touches three files: `SiliconDigitization.cpp`, `SiliconDigitizationTests.cpp`, and `upstream/marlin/Backend.cpp`. It bounds CLHEP Poisson expectations and rejects float underflow; rebuild and all tests passed again in 3.00 seconds.

Limitations remain explicit: no original Marlin event-loop comparison, pulse/ADC model, timing integration, radiation dependence or detector-wide occupancy validation. MIP and shower validation belong to the coordinator’s campaign; no performance acceptance claimed.
